reviewScope: Read-only review of finalized annual and GreenFrame supplements, their declared source inputs and selected raw modeled outputs; separate from the scored frozen packet and main claims result.

judgment.summary: Source hashes, matched-origin traffic, first-initial byte selection, page weighting and unit arithmetic are consistent. Raw GreenFrame sample medians match the client annual projection where completed. No numerical correction found. Model accuracy and raw-counter instrumentation were not independently remeasured.

validation.model: CO2.js 0.19.0 / SWDM v4 as declared; model implementation not independently rerun

trafficScope.calibrationPopulation: US government websites, 2025 analytics and December 2025 CrUX ranks
trafficScope.limitation: September 2026 CrUX origin popularity bucket, not exact ordinal or measured site analytics; cohort median extrapolation has no calibrated site-level interval. Period and population differ. All five origins were found, so no unranked extrapolation or parent-domain substitution is involved.

limitations: All seven SWDM initial-transfer inputs are complete within the bounded main-session protocol; this does not cover every reader interaction, full article scrolling or all site URLs. The solar server statement does not set the calculator’s green-hosting flag.

The client sample is homepage plus oven guide. Its global 494 gCO2e/kWh comparison factor applies to modeled reader-device operation, not the historically documented off-grid server system. Do not compare these client values with the publisher’s historical server-only Wh per unique visitor.

SWDM initial loads use fresh-context CDP main-session received bytes at 1280×800 with a three-second observation window; partial/unfinished transfers remain explicit. Equal weights across the selected editorial sample are not measured popularity.

GreenFrame 2.0.1 uses Chromium 110 in the pinned Playwright image and a fixed Chrome/89 user agent, unlike the Chromium 156 transfer collector. Fresh contexts load then wait three seconds, without consent action or scrolling; startup warm-up is excluded, shutdown remains inside the window.

GreenFrame estimates CPU, memory, disk and display from resource counters using synthetic 45 W CPU and 14 W screen coefficients. No baseline subtraction; shared workstation activity was uncontrolled. It is not wall-meter electricity, whole-device energy, network/server/embodied energy or full reading-session energy.

Client annual scenario uses each page’s median of three repetitions and a 50/50 mix of only two pages. Manifest aggregate metrics are means and must not be substituted for medians. Default 494 gCO2e/kWh is an assumed comparison factor, not measured audience electricity; raw GreenFrame built-in CO2 figures use their own factor and are not the annual headline.
corrections: Label both annual results as model scenarios based on estimated pageviews, never measured annual emissions, a forecast, a complete organizational footprint or a DCR badge.
Keep SWDM operational and embodied browsing scope separate from GreenFrame client operation. Never add the two values or substitute GreenFrame for SWDM device emissions.

Preserve the 100% first-visit assumption and equal sampled-page proxy; actual page mix, repeat-visit share and audience electricity are unknown. Minimum/maximum sampled-page sensitivities and repetition ranges are not confidence intervals or bounds on true footprint.
Do not turn the 10% sensitivity parameter into estimated achievable savings. Any savings attribution needs a matched before/after measurement and affected traffic share.

scopeProvenanceRevalidation.judgment: Scope provenance corrected without changing numerical inputs, assumptions, scenarios or prior numerical review. No report or score edits.
